info.name: For_You API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the For_You store and influencer affiliate system.

1. Set baseUrl (default http://localhost:8000).
2. Run Auth > Login with a customer, influencer or admin account. The test script saves the token into customerToken, influencerToken or adminToken.
3. Replace the ID variables (categoryId, productId, orderId, ...) with real values from your database.
4. Payment/shipping webhook requests sign the raw body automatically with the secrets in webhookSecret / shippingWebhookSecret.

Order creation requires Idempotency-Key. Use a new UUID for each distinct order.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login, social login, profile, password reset and logout. Login saves the token in role-specific variables.

request.description: Create a customer account and return a Sanctum token. The test script saves it as customerToken.
Login with email/password. The test script stores the token in token and in the role-specific variable (customerToken, influencerToken or adminToken).
Send a password reset link. Always returns the same message to avoid account enumeration.
Reset the password using the token from the email.
Web-only: redirect to the provider. Supported providers: google, apple.
Mobile social login. Google requires id_token; Apple accepts id_token or access_token.
Return the authenticated user.
Update the profile. For an avatar upload use POST with _method=PUT and multipart/form-data. Changing email requires current_password.
Change the password and revoke all other tokens.
Revoke the current access token.

item.name: Customer
item.description: Public storefront and authenticated customer flows: cart, checkout, orders, addresses and notifications.

request.description: Home page payload: banners, categories, featured, new arrivals, offers and influencer picks.
List active categories with their active children.
Category details with children and active products.
Paginated active products. Price filters use the effective (discounted) price.
Latest 12 featured products.
Paginated products with the largest discounts first.
Paginated newest products.
Active product details with category.
Public list of active influencers (no email/phone).
Active products linked to an influencer.
Track a promotional link click (deduplicated per visitor) and return the ref/product.
List the customer addresses.
Create an address (max 10). The first address becomes the default.

body.raw:
{
    "label": "Home",
    "recipient_name": "Ahmed Ali",
    "phone": "01012345678",
    "city": "Cairo",
    "country": "Egypt",
    "address_line": "12 Nile Street",
    "notes": "Near the metro",
    "is_default": true
}

request.description: Update an address.
Set this address as the default.
Delete an address. If it was the default, the latest remaining address becomes default.
Get the current cart.
Add a product to the cart.
Update cart item quantity (0 removes it).
Remove an item from the cart.
Clear the cart.
Quote the cart total, discount and shipping without creating an order.
Create an order from the cart and clear it in one transaction. Idempotency-Key is optional but recommended.
Create an order directly. Idempotency-Key is REQUIRED. Reusing the same key with the same body replays the 201 response; using it with a different body returns 422.
Paginated customer orders with items, payment and shipping.
Customer order details.
Cancel an order that is still cancellable.
Paginated notifications for the authenticated user.
Latest 20 unread notifications.
Mark one notification as read.
Mark all notifications as read.
Delete a notification.

item.name: Influencer
item.description: Influencer dashboard, products, links, sales, wallet and withdrawal requests.

request.description: Sales, commission and wallet summary plus recent commissions and linked products.
Products linked to the influencer with the effective commission percentage.
Default commission percentage and per-product percentages.
Promotional links with clicks, conversions and conversion rate.
Sales and commission totals. Customer PII is intentionally excluded.
Wallet balance, held commissions, available balance and transactions.
Request a withdrawal. Amount must be at least the configured minimum and not exceed the available balance.
Paginated withdrawal requests for the influencer.

item.name: Admin Catalog
item.description: Dashboard, categories, products, banners and coupons.

request.description: Admin dashboard stats and the latest 10 orders. Financial fields require reports.view.
Paginated categories.
Create a category. Use multipart/form-data when uploading an image.
Category details with parent, children and products.
Update a category. Cycles in the tree are rejected.
Delete a category only when it has no products or children.
Paginated products.
Create a product. Use multipart/form-data with images[] for uploads.

body.raw:
{
    "category_id": 1,
    "name": "Wireless Headphones",
    "description": "Noise cancelling headphones",
    "short_description": "Over-ear, 30h battery",
    "price": 1500,
    "discount_price": 1200,
    "stock": 25,
    "sku": "WH-001",
    "is_featured": true,
    "is_active": true
}

request.description: Product details with category and influencers.
Update a product. Use remove_images[] and images[] to manage the gallery.
Soft-delete a product.
Link an influencer to a product. commission_percentage=null means the default percentage.
Paginated banners.
Create a banner. image is required: use multipart/form-data and select a file.
Banner details.
Update a banner (multipart when replacing the image).
Delete a banner and its image.
Paginated coupons.
Create a coupon. Codes are uppercased; percent value cannot exceed 100.
Coupon details.
Update a coupon.
Delete a coupon only when used_count is 0; otherwise disable it.

item.name: Admin Orders & Payments
item.description: Orders, shipping, payments, customers and reports.

query.description: Order number, customer name or phone

request.description: Paginated orders with customer, influencer, payment and shipping.
Full order details.
Move an order through the state machine. Illegal transitions return 422.
Create a shipment for an order that is ready_for_shipping (payment must be paid by default).
Paginated shipments.
Shipment details with order items and payment.
Update shipment metadata.
Advance the shipment status. Allowed transitions only.
Paginated payments.
Payment details with customer.
Confirm, fail or refund a payment. transaction_id is required for paid.
Paginated customers with orders count and total spent.
Customer profile, stats and recent orders.
Enable/disable a customer and revoke tokens when disabled.
Aggregate sales, orders, customers, influencers, commissions and pending withdrawals.
Daily sales for delivered orders in the configured timezone.
Influencer sales and earned commissions.
Best-selling products by quantity.

item.name: Admin Influencers & Withdrawals
item.description: Influencers, product links, promotional links, wallets and withdrawals.

request.description: Paginated influencers with wallets.
Create an influencer account and wallet.
Influencer details with wallet, products, links and commissions.
Update an influencer. An empty password leaves it unchanged.
Delete an influencer only when there is no balance, pending withdrawals or pending commissions.
Bulk link products with optional per-product percentages.
Generate a promotional link, optionally for a product linked to the influencer.
Sales and commissions for one influencer.
Sales and commissions for all influencers.
Paginated promotional links with sales totals.
Promotional link details.
Update a link. product_id cannot change after the link has orders.
Toggle a promotional link.
All influencer wallets with totals.
Wallet details, pending withdrawals and transactions.
All wallet transactions.
Paginated withdrawal requests.
Approve/reject/pay a withdrawal. Approve needs withdrawals.approve; pay needs withdrawals.pay. With four-eyes enabled the approver cannot pay.
All permissions grouped by group.
All roles with permissions and user counts.
Create a role. You cannot grant permissions you do not hold.
Role details with permissions.
Update a role. The super-admin role is immutable.
Delete a role only when no employees use it.
Paginated employees.
Create an employee and assign roles. You cannot grant roles above your own level.
Employee details with roles and permissions.
Update an employee. Password changes revoke all their tokens.
Enable/disable an employee and revoke tokens when disabled.
Delete an employee.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description: Public signature-protected payment and shipping webhooks. Pre-request scripts compute the HMAC signature.

request.description: EasyKash payment webhook. The pre-request script signs the exact raw body with HMAC-SHA256 using webhookSecret. The amount must match orders.total within 0.01.
Shipping webhook. The pre-request script signs the raw body with HMAC-SHA256 using shippingWebhookSecret. At least tracking_number or order_number is required.
